description: This course exposes students to the fundamentals of risk analytics in the financial services sector. Students will be taught on the fundamentals of financial services and financial risks. They will also learn about interest rate risk analytics and credit risk analytics.
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must have completed BT2101 at a grade of at least D and must have completed BT2102 at a grade of at least D )
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) BT2101:D AND COURSES (1) BT2102:D)
title: Risk Analytics for Financial Services
